name: Wyndham Fantasea Condo Chalong
shortDescription: Wyndham-branded condominium of 398 units in three 8-storey buildings in Chalong, near Robinson Lifestyle, from compact 1-bedroom to 3-bedroom units.
description:
Wyndham Fantasea Condo Chalong is a branded condominium by Fantasea Plus, a Phuket developer that also builds Wyndham Fantasea Condo Rawai and Fantasea Condo Kamala. The project has 398 apartments in three eight-storey buildings set around a large central pool, on a site of about 7,420 sqm in Chalong. Wyndham provides the brand and its reservation system for owners who want to rent out their unit.
Units range from compact one-bedroom apartments of 28 sqm to two-bedroom units of 56 sqm and three-bedroom units of 92 sqm, sold either within the foreign freehold quota or on leasehold. Shared facilities include the pool courtyard, a gym, a cafe, a lobby, co-working space and a meeting room, with 24-hour security and parking for every unit.
Robinson Lifestyle Chalong, the Chalong Muay Thai street and the international schools of the south are close by; Chalong Pier is about 3.5 km away and the airport about 56 minutes by car. Sources give completion dates between Q4 2026 and April 2027.
